title: Customer Service Tools Operation Manager / Specialist - Brazil Market
description:
About the Role

At Keeta , we’re building next-generation service experiences for the food delivery industry. We’re looking for a Customer Service Tools Operation Manager to own and scale customer service tools, processes, and service journeys across users, merchants, and riders .

This role focuses on designing end-to-end service operations—from AI-powered customer service tools to human support workflows —while ensuring frontline teams can resolve issues quickly, consistently, and at scale. You’ll play a key role in localizing service experiences for the Brazilian market and driving continuous improvement through data and customer insights.

What You’ll Do

  • Own Customer Service Tools & Rules
  • Define and optimize service rules and operational standards across users, merchants, and riders.
  • Manage and continuously improve customer service tools, ensuring they support fair, efficient, and scalable service delivery.
  • Design End-to-End Service Journeys
  • Build and optimize the full service journey from AI self-service to manual customer support , including routing logic, service layering, escalation paths, and risk control.
  • Ensure service flows are clear, efficient, and easy to operate for frontline agents.
  • Localize for the Brazil Market
  • Design takeaway service scenarios aligned with Brazilian customer habits, behaviors, and expectations .
  • Develop localized service processes, solutions, and customer communication strategies.
  • Enable Frontline Teams
  • Translate complex service logic into simple, standardized workflows for customer service agents.
  • Continuously optimize processes to improve resolution efficiency and first-contact resolution.
  • Data-Driven Optimization
  • Analyze service data, tool performance, and customer feedback to identify pain points and root causes.
  • Partner with business and product teams to drive improvements that reduce issue recurrence and service costs.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Support complex service operations with a frontline team of approximately 40 agents .
  • Work closely with product, operations, and business teams to co-create and optimize service strategies.

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience in the food delivery, on-demand, or marketplace industry.
  • Strong understanding of customer service tools, service rules, and operational logic for users, merchants, and riders.
  • Proven experience in service process design and end-to-end service journey management.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to turn data into actionable insights.
  • Clear, structured thinker with strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Customer-first mindset with a strong sense of ownership.
  • Practical, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in fast-paced environments.
  • Experience with the Brazilian market is required.
  • Experience supporting or managing frontline customer service teams is a plus.

Why Join Keeta

  • Own and scale customer service tools and operations in a high-growth food delivery business .
  • Deeply influence service experience and operational strategy.
  • Collaborate in a fast-moving, tech-driven, and international environment.
  • Learn and grow through cross-functional and cross-cultural collaboration.

title: Financial Planning Analyst
description:
What is Teachable?

Teachable is trusted by creator-educators around the world to grow their impact and income. From online courses and communities to memberships and downloads, Teachable's digital learning products help creator-educators drive meaningful connection and sustainable revenue. With industry-best ecommerce tools, easily toggled on directly within the platform, creators can confidently maximize their earnings, while getting paid directly by their audience. Teachable's unmatched focus on the student learning experience also ensures creators can make a positive and influential impact on their communities—entirely on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creator-educators use Teachable to share their knowledge, reaching millions of students around the world. To learn more, visit teachable.com.

Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? Now part of the global portfolio, whose platforms have helped creators earn more than $10 billion, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!

What is this role?

Strong financial analysis and forecasting enables Teachable to determine how best to deploy our resources to continue (and accelerate) our growth. We’re looking for an FP&A analystwith a strong sense of ownership who can assess the opportunities ahead of us and help Teachable make sound business decisions. This position reports to the FP&A Manager and will be heavily involved in various finance needs of the company, with an emphasis on financial reporting, forecasting, cross-department partnerships, and data integrity,

You will have full visibility of Teachable’s P&L focused on labour spend, and build reports to monitor our labour financial performance and help identify opportunities. You will be responsible for deeply understanding and managing the labour model, labour KPIs, unit economics and forecasting models.

If you enjoy the challenge of transforming business questions into financial models and are passionate about the creator economy, we want you on our Finance team at Teachable!

What You’ll Do:

  • Own Teachable Monthly Labour process, including updating actuals and forecasts;
  • Support the buildup of labour-related Balance Sheet accounts and Cash Flow statements and own the monthly updates and analyses.
  • Collaborate with HR and various teams on workforce planning, analyzing financial data, and develop actionable insights.
  • Own labour reporting package consolidated by our FP&A team and sent to our parent company, Hotmart, on a monthly basis.
  • Be the focal point for all labour cost data and partner closely with HR team to develop reports and dashboards for financial and other business needs.
  • Provide continuous improvements on tools and analysis methodologies, elevating visibility to key stakeholders.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in relevant fields (Business, Economics, Finance, Engineering, Accounting)
  • 3+ years of experience in FP&A, Business Operations or HR Finance Business Partner
  • Strong modeling (Excel) skills
  • Ability to handle multiple projects and to analyze a big volume of data and support on reporting results to senior leadership
  • Strategic data analysis, BI tooling, SQL and database experience (Sigma) a plus
  • Excited to work independently and chart your own course, while knowing when to seek guidance

While Teachable maintains our NY office for local employees to use, we operate as a remote-first culture in order to give our employees added flexibility. In order to maintain connection and create a community beyond the screen, Teachable holds in-person events throughout the year, where employees and teams can come together for bonding, strategic alignment, goal-setting, and celebrations!

title: Senior Procurement Specialist (Indirect Products)
description:
Job Title: Senior Procurement Specialist (Indirect Products) – LAM

Location: Brazil (able to travel around LAM countries)

Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Overview

We are seeking an experienced Senior Procurement Specialist to lead indirect products procurement activities especially third party products procurement across LAM. The ideal candidate will possess deep industry expertise, strong supply chain management skills, and fluency in English to drive cross-regional collaboration, ensuring efficient and compliant procurement processes that align with company strategic goals.

Key Responsibilities

1 Supplier Development & Management

  • Identify, evaluate, and onboard indirect products’ suppliers across LAM and globally, ensuring compliance and performance alignment.
  • Conduct regular supplier assessments (quality, cost, delivery) to optimize supply chain resilience.

2 Strategic Sourcing & Negotiation

  • Develop and execute procurement strategies for different product categories, leading negotiations on pricing, contracts, payment terms and delivery terms to achieve cost-saving targets.
  • Manage Long-Term Agreements (LTAs) in compliance with local regulations and corporate policies.

3 Procurement Execution & Documentation

  • Oversee end-to-end procurement processes, including purchase order (PO) drafting and issuance, delivery coordination, goods receipt coordination, installation and acceptance coordination, payment documentation follow-up and procurement related documentation archiving.
  • Ensure seamless order fulfillment: Track deliveries, resolve discrepancies with suppliers/warehouse teams, and maintain accurate records in OA, ERP systems (e.g., SAP).
  • Validate compliance: Verify product specifications during goods acceptance and ensure invoices align with contractual terms before payment approval.

4 Compliance & Risk Mitigation

  • Ensure adherence to local regulations depending on product categories, e.g. Medical Device Regulation, ISO 13485 standards, and internal compliance protocols.

5 Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with HQ PUR, BU, PM, CS, OP, LG, Quality and Legal teams to ensure purchased products meet technical specifications and regulatory requirements.
  • Support New Product Introduction (NPI) projects with supplier sourcing and cost analysis.

6 Data Analysis & Reporting

  • Utilize company own systems and excel to track procurement metrics, generate cost analyses, and report on supplier performance and market trends.

Qualifications

Essential Requirements:

  • 5+ years of procurement experience in the medical device sector, with at least 3 years focused on third-party products/consumables for medical imaging equipments.
  • Procurement experiences for certain indirect product, including but not limited to Administrative & HR, IT & Services, Infrastructure & Engineering, Marketing, MRO (Maintenance, Repair, and Operations) Equipment & Tools.
  • Fluent English with proven ability to draft contracts, lead international meetings, and negotiate cross-culturally.
  • Expertise in procurement tools, cost modeling, and Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) analysis.
  • Hands-on experience with procurement execution workflows (PO management, inventory reconciliation, payment documentation).
  • Strong understanding of local medical device regulations and quality management systems.
  • Responsible, detail-oriented, and highly organized with a commitment to accuracy in documentation and process execution.
  • Integrity and strong teamwork spirit – Ability to build trust with stakeholders and collaborate effectively in cross-functional and multicultural environments.
  • Willingness to actively search for resources and travel cross LAM and globally

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Possess a Diploma or bachelor’s degree in business, Economics, or Supply Chain, International Business or Business Administration, or a related field
  • Prior experience in multinational corporations or medical device distributors preferred.
  • Multitasking skills and the ability to work under time-constraints and pressure.
  • Strong research and data analysis skill.

SOBRE A OPORTUNIDADE:

Estamos em busca de um(a) Especialista / Coordenador Fiscal Sênior para atuar com foco em ICMS, ICMS-ST, DIFAL e parametrizações fiscais em ERP, fortalecendo o compliance tributário e promovendo a eficiência e automação dos processos fiscais do Grupo Hecke.

Essa é uma oportunidade para quem deseja unir visão estratégica, domínio técnico e protagonismo em um ambiente dinâmico e em crescimento.

  • Realizar análises, validações, conferência e apurações de ICMS, incluindo ICMS-ST, DIFAL e regimes especiais aplicáveis.
  • Elaborar e revisar apuração de tributos indiretos (ICMS, ICMS-ST e IPI) e impostos retidos (PIS/COFINS, CSLL e ISS).

  • Efetuar conferência e emissão de NF-e e NFS-e (entrada, saída, devolução, remessa, transferência, carta de correção, dentre outras).
  • Apoiar a área de projetos em implementações e melhorias sistêmicas envolvendo tributos indiretos.
  • Atuar junto ao time de TI para validação de regras fiscais e testes de sistemas.
  • Acompanhar alterações na legislação tributária estadual e federal, avaliando impactos e realizando ajustes necessários.
  • Prestar suporte técnico às áreas internas quanto às dúvidas fiscais e parametrizações tributárias.
  • Interagir com auditorias internas e externas, fornecendo documentações e esclarecimentos necessários.

  • Preparação e envio de documentos à contabilidade e áreas correlacionadas.
  • Verificação de pedidos de compras versus Notas Fiscais de entrada e saída.
  • Acompanhar a internalização dos processos fiscais.

PERFIL E COMPETÊNCIAS ESPERADAS:

  • Postura analítica e senso crítico apurado;
  • Autonomia, proatividade e senso de dono;
  • Boa comunicação com diferentes áreas (TI, Contabilidade e Jurídico);
  • Organização, resiliência e comprometimento com prazos;
  • Foco em melhoria contínua e inovação nos processos fiscais.

REQUISITOS:

  • Graduação em Ciências Contábeis, Administração, Direito ou áreas correlatas;
  • 5 a 7 anos de experiência na área fiscal, com foco em ICMS e parametrizações;
  • Conhecimento Técnico: Sólido domínio em ICMS, ICMS-ST, DIFAL e em obrigações acessórias (SPED Fiscal, GIA, EFD ICMS/IPI).
  • Experiência prática com parametrizações fiscais em ERPs como SAP, TOTVS, Oracle, etc..
  • Vivência com automatização de processos fiscais e integração de sistemas.
  • Pacote Office intermediário a avançado (Excel, Power BI, VBA ou RPA).

DIFERENCIAIS QUE NOS ENCANTAM:

  • Especialização ou cursos focados em tributação indireta, automação fiscal ou tecnologia aplicada à área fiscal (ex: parametrização em ERP, análise de dados).
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas fiscais (Synchro, Mastersaf, Dootax, Systax).

O QUE OFERECEMOS:

  • Contratação Prestação de Serviços com remuneração compatível com o mercado;
  • Ambiente colaborativo e orientado a resultados;
  • Oportunidade de crescimento e protagonismo na área fiscal.

Here are a few names you might recognize: Cathay Pacific Airways, Singapore Airlines, Lufthansa, etc.

With the future of travel always insight, we created Smart Traveller, a mobile-app rewards program underpinned by in-house technology. We are fast-moving and always evolving to drive our purpose of making travel better.

Join our family today.

Together, we'll make travel better.

title: AI Architect
description:
AI Architect

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior AI Architect to define and lead the technical vision of our Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning platform.

This is a hands-on, senior leadership role where you will design the end-to-end architecture that takes AI models from experimentation to reliable, scalable production systems . You will work at the intersection of Data Science, Software Engineering, and DevOps , acting as the technical authority for all AI initiatives across the company.

Beyond building models, your mission is to design the infrastructure, MLOps pipelines, and architectural standards that enable high-quality AI and Generative AI solutions to operate at scale. You will guide the evolution of our platform from traditional machine learning to Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) .

What You’ll Do

AI Strategy & Architecture

  • Own and define the end-to-end technical architecture for AI and ML solutions, ensuring scalability, reliability, security, and cost efficiency.
  • Select and standardize technology stacks, frameworks, cloud services, databases, and tools for model development, training, and serving.
  • Design and implement robust MLOps pipelines (CI/CD for ML) to automate training, testing, deployment, monitoring, and retraining of models.

Technical Leadership & Collaboration

  • Act as the technical authority for AI, providing mentorship and guidance to Senior Data Scientists and ML Engineers.
  • Partner closely with Product Managers and executive stakeholders to translate business requirements into clear, actionable AI architectures and technical specifications.
  • Lead architectural discussions, code reviews, and design reviews to ensure high engineering standards and best practices .

Innovation & Development

  • Stay ahead of emerging AI trends, with a strong focus on Generative AI, LLMs, RAG architectures, computer vision, and predictive analytics .
  • Oversee the integration of AI models into production systems , including REST APIs, microservices, and edge or embedded environments.
  • Establish and enforce data governance, privacy (GDPR/CCPA), security, and ethical AI standards across the AI platform.

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in software engineering or data science, with 3+ years in an AI/ML architecture or technical leadership role .
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Mathematics, or a related field .
  • Strong proficiency in Python , with working knowledge of Java or C/C++ .
  • Deep hands-on experience with machine learning frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, Keras, or scikit-learn.
  • Extensive experience with cloud-based AI platforms , including AWS SageMaker, Azure AI Studio, or Google Cloud Vertex AI .
  • Proven expertise in MLOps and DevOps , including tools such as Docker, Kubernetes, Kubeflow, MLflow, Airflow, or Jenkins .
  • Experience working with vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Milvus, Weaviate) and big data technologies such as Spark, Kafka, or Databricks .

Nice to Have

  • PhD in Artificial Intelligence, Deep Learning, or a related field .
  • Experience designing, fine-tuning, and deploying Large Language Models (LLMs) and RAG-based systems .
  • Experience deploying AI models to edge or resource-constrained environments .
  • Cloud architecture certifications such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect or Google Professional Cloud Architect .

title: Customer Success Specialist, Life Sciences
description:
JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.

The Role

As a Customer Success Specialist, you will help professors at leading universities in the US integrate JoVE videos into their courses to improve teaching outcomes and student success. You'll play a key role in ensuring users get the most value from their JoVE subscription.

Responsibilities:

  • Conduct daily outreach to Faculty (via calls, emails, and 1:1 demos) to set up JoVE integrations in courses and increase product usage.
  • Increase JoVE adoption by delivering product awareness sessions across existing customer universities and research institutes.
  • Grow engagement and usage by delivering presentations at (1) exhibits and conferences, (2) university seminars and workshops, and (3) onsite customer visits.
  • Strengthen subscription renewal outcomes by ensuring smooth implementation support, and consistent usage of JoVE resources.
  • Influence product decisions by communicating customer feedback to sales, product, and marketing teams.

Requirements:

  • A Master's degree or PhD in Life Science disciplines.
  • 1 to 2 years of experience in sales or business development, preferably in EdTech, SAAS or STEM publishing.
  • Experience in science communications, academic outreach or other customer-facing roles is preferred.
  • Fluent communication skills English.
  • Knowledge of education, market trends, and challenges in assigned content areas i.e. Biology, Chemistry, Medicine, Physics, Engineering, or Psychology.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with a passion for remote relationship-building.
  • Experience in networking using cold calling is preferred.

Please share your resume in English.

Why Join JoVE?

  • You can expect compensation packages competitively placed within the local market.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and in improving student learning in science education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

title: Lead Data Platform Architect
description:
Lead Data Platform Architect

Mars is a family-owned business with more than $50 billion in global sales. We produce some of the world’s best-loved brands: M&M’s®, SNICKERS®, TWIX®, MILKY WAY®, DOVE®, PEDIGREE®, ROYAL CANIN®, WHISKAS®, EXTRA®, ORBIT®, 5™, SKITTLES®, BEN’S ORIGINAL®, and COCOAVIA®. Alongside our consumer brands, we proudly take care of half of the world’s pets through our nutrition, health and services businesses such as Banfield Pet Hospitals™, BluePearl®, Linnaeus, AniCura, VCA™ and Pet Partners™. Headquartered in McLean, VA, Mars operates in more than 80 countries. The Mars Five Principles – Quality, Responsibility, Mutuality, Efficiency and Freedom – inspire our 160,000 Diverse Associates to act daily towards creating the world we want tomorrow.

The Lead Data Platform Architect is instrumental in delivering scalable, repeatable and agile data and platform architectures to unlock and drive business value across Finance, Commercial, R&D, MGS Labs and Innovation:

As the Lead Data Platform Architect in the Enterprise Data & Platform team, your key responsibilities are as follows:

TECHNICAL PROFICIENCY AND LEADERSHIP

  • Lead the definition and execution of data architecture strategies across multiple business domains and data platforms.
  • Drive the development of scalable, integrated data models and architectures across raw, trusted, and harmonized zones.
  • Define and execute the data product strategy for assigned business areas in collaboration with analytics and business teams.
  • Act as a thought leader and trusted advisor, supporting teams in understanding business objectives, data requirements, processes, and enabling technologies.
  • Ensure all data architecture efforts are aligned with the broader business vision and strategic priorities and provide architectural oversight across delivery initiatives.
  • Collaborate with other data architects to ensure consistent and integrated use of data assets across the organization.
  • Identify cross-segment and cross-function data dependencies or issues and lead resolution efforts.
  • Provide strategic guidance on data domains, process analysis, data analysis, and modelling techniques.
  • Mentor and coach solution / data architects and engineers to build internal data architecture capability.
  • Advocate for best practices, tools, and methods related to data architecture.
  • Ensure understanding and compliance of data protection policies, security policies, and GDPR

DELIVERABLE INVOLVEMENT & OWNERSHIP

  • Reference Architectures: Own and maintain reusable architectural patterns
  • High-Level Designs (HLDs): Review and approve HLDs from Solution Architects and 3rd parties
  • Key Design Decisions (KDDs): Own and govern major architectural decisions for alignment with the Architecture Review Board and beyond
  • Architecture Option Assessments: Lead decisioning on tooling, modelling, and patterns

DATA & PLATFORM ARCHITECTURE OWNERSHIP

  • Develop and maintain current and future state data architectures, models, and roadmaps.
  • Promote awareness and understanding of data architectures across the organization.
  • Review and validate high-level models and reference architecture libraries
  • Approve changes to shared or enterprise-wide data models

Knowledge and Experience

ESSENTIAL:

  • Previous experience as a Senior Data or Platform Architect essential
  • Proven experience as a senior data or platform architect, or similar leadership role in data & platform strategy.
  • Strong background in data modelling, architecture frameworks, and modern data integration methods.
  • Deep understanding of cloud-based data platforms (Azure) and tools (Databricks, SQL, ADF etc) as well as analytics solutions.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence and align across business and technology functions.
  • Experience building and evolving data & platform architectures that scale and adapt to changing business needs.
  • Passion for coaching and enabling others with a collaborative leadership approach.
  • Knowledgeable in Data Source systems (eg. SAP) and Data Lake technology
  • Stakeholder management and communication skills
  • Strong interpersonal skills
  • Fluent in writing and speaking English

DESIRED:

  • Previous experience in CPG industry would be ideal
  • Experience at operating in a complex global matrix organisation
  • Experience at collaborating with cross-functional partners
  • High drive for results and an ability to work with minimum input

What can you expect from Mars?

  • Work with diverse and talented Associates, all guided by the Five Principles.
  • Join a purpose-driven company, where we’re striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today.
  • Best-in-class learning and development support from day one, including access to our in-house Mars University.
  • An industry-competitive salary and benefits package, including a company bonus.

Mars is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you need assistance or an accommodation during the application process because of a disability, it is available upon request. The company is pleased to provide such assistance, and no applicant will be penalized as a result of such a request.

  1. The Tax Senior/Manager will be responsible for the management of indirect taxes, tax compliance and tax planning, ensuring compliance with current legislation and the optimization of the tax burden;

  4. Manage and respond to federal, state, and municipal tax audits, including coordinating documentation and liaising with auditors and tax authorities.
  5. Analyze changes in Brazilian tax legislation and assess potential business impacts, providing recommendations for compliance.

  1. Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or Law. Advanced degree or CPA certification preferred.
  2. Solid experience in indirect taxes, tax compliance and tax planning;

Language:

Equal Employment Statement

At Temu, we are proud to be an employer that builds a diverse community. We encourage all qualified individuals to apply and join our team. We are dedicated to providing a work environment free from discrimination and harassment, where all employees are treated with respect and dignity.

Apply today to join Temu and be part of a dynamic and innovative company.

title: Supervisor (a) De Excelência Operacional - Qualidade
description:
No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).

A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Now part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, whose platforms have helped creators earn more than $10 billion, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!

About Your Team

At Teachable, our Data team aims to support company data-driven decision-making. Reporting to the Head of Data, you will collaborate with business and product teams to validate hypotheses, answer complex business questions, help the company in uncertain scenarios, perform data experiments, and disseminate actionable insights.

About You

You will take the lead in exploring data and cross-business variables, uncovering patterns and trends, identifying new data sources, and delivering valuable insights to various departments.

What You’ll Do:

  • Develop and execute complex data analyses using statistical techniques and modeling to validate business hypotheses.
  • Detect patterns, trends and anomalies in data and translate them into actionable insights that drive strategic decisions and business growth.
  • Serve as a key expert in data analysis, providing guidance and best practices to team members and stakeholders across the company.

What You’ll Bring:

  • 3+ years of experience within data analytics and/or data science.
  • Strong curiosity for uncovering insights from data.
  • Proven experience in delivering data studies focused on generating and sharing actionable data.
  • Deep understanding of statistical methods, including hypothesis testing and statistical modeling.
  • Proficiency in SQL for extracting data directly from source systems.
  • Sharp critical thinking and analytical problem-solving abilities.
  • Enjoy working in a dynamic environment with fast learning and deliveries.
  • Advanced English proficiency (conversational, listening, writing.)

Nice to Have:

  • Ability to perform data cleaning and processing steps using Python or R languages.
  • Hands-on experience in building Machine Learning models.

This is a fully remote role based in Brazil, and you’ll collaborate closely with teams across the U.S. and Brazil. Your work will follow Brasilia Standard Time, and you’ll be hired as a CLT contract employee with compensation in BRL.

title: Especialista em Planejamento de Mina (Ventilaçao)
description:
Especialista em Planejamento de Mina (Foco: Ventilação)
 
Excelente oportunidade para uma pessoa qualificada e com experiência na área de planejamento de mina, foco em ventilação.
 
A empresa
Nosso cliente é uma das maiores produtoras de ouro do mundo em atuação no país.
 
 A posição
Em um ambiente de mineração subterrânea onde a ventilação é o pilar fundamental da segurança e produtividade, você terá o desafio de conduzir o planejamento estratégico de sistemas de ventilação e refrigeração de minas subterrâneas. Essa posição exige expertise técnica para assegurar que a disciplina esteja em acordo com normas regulatórias e padrões internos. Trata-se de uma oportunidade única de planejar sistemas de ventilação de alta complexidade em minerações profundas. Suas decisões contribuirão diretamente em assegurar um ambiente de trabalho confortável e seguro para os times operacionais.
 
Responsabilidades
 
 Como especialista no tema, você será responsável por dimensionar e operacionalizar sistemas de ventilação que sustentem as operações de frentes de trabalho em acordo com o planejamento anual e estratégico de produção. Suas atribuições também incluem colaboração no design da mina, participação em projetos e comitês de emergência, execução de tarefas técnicas, com foco em resultados práticos e conformidade:
  • Simulação e Modelagem: Empregar softwares como Deswik, Ventsim para simulações termodinâmicas do fluxo de ar na mina, incluindo cenários de produção, dimensionamento de frota, geotermia bem como cenários de emergência. Validar os modelos com dados reais para assegurar a calibração do modelo.
  • Integração com Planos de Produção e Lavra: Analisar impactos básicos da ventilação em planos de lavra, desenvolvimento, sondagem e infraestrutura, colaborando com as diferentes áreas e assegurar resposta a variações operacionais. Ser o guardião dos padrões internos, assegurando equilíbrio entre segurança e metas de produção.
  • Conformidade com Normas Regulamentadoras: Garantir adesão às normas principais, como NR-22, ABNT NBR 16401, padrões internos da companhia, realizando revisões regulares e melhorias nos padrões.
  • Gestão de Perdas e Recirculações: Identificar perdas de ar através de inspeções em campo com instrumentos de medição, propor estratégias para reduzir recirculações, perdas. Interagir com as diversas disciplinas para construção do sequenciamento de atividades para melhorar a eficiência.
  • Melhoria de qualidade das instalações de ventilação: Desenvolver soluções com foco em melhores materiais, métodos ou tecnologias que assegurem a conformidade das vedações das estruturas que compõe o sistema de ventilação.
 
 Requisitos
É essencial que o profissional possua as seguintes habilidades e qualificações:
  • Formação Acadêmica: Graduação em Engenharia (Minas, Mecânica, Elétrica ou Civil) com CREA ativo.
  • Especialização: Conhecimentos em aerodinâmica básica de minas, segurança subterrânea e princípios de sistemas de ar, com interesse em certificações em ventilação.
  • Conhecimentos Técnicos: Familiaridade com softwares de planejamento de minas (ex.: Deswik, Datamine) e ventilação (ex.: Ventsim). Elaboração de apresentações executivas. Análise estatística de dados. Compreensão de normas técnicas nacionais.
  • Experiência Profissional: Mínimo de 4 anos em mineração subterrânea, com pelo menos 2 anos em atividades relacionadas a ventilação de minas subterrâneas. Experiência em projetos de média escala, incluindo monitoramento e ajustes operacionais.
 
Requisitos Desejáveis
  • Habilidades interpessoais para trabalho em equipe e poder de negociação.
  • Inglês avançado para comunicação com times internacionais e compreensão de bibliografia técnica.
  • Pós-Graduação na área de Ventilação ou Engenharia de Minas;
 
 Remuneração
A empresa proporcionará um pacote atrativo de remuneração e benefícios.
 
 Contate-nos
Por favor enviar CV, preferencialmente como documento Microsoft Word

Title : Director - Regional CMC

Location : Brazil, Remote

Director – Regional CMC

Objective:

The Director – Regional CMC will manage the Regional CMC team, ensuring seamless integration between global Regulatory CMC strategies and local affiliate execution. This role is pivotal in driving regional alignment, efficiency, and consistency in post-approval submissions across a diverse product portfolio, including small molecules, biologics, vaccines, and plasma-derived therapies. The Director – Regional CMC will champion the development and implementation of regional strategies, fostering collaboration and process improvement to meet regulatory requirements effectively and efficiently.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Oversee and manage the Regional CMC team, providing guidance, training, and support to ensure high performance and professional development.
  • Foster a collaborative and inclusive team environment, promoting knowledge sharing and best practices.
  • Develop and execute a strategic vision for the Regional CMC Liaison function, aligning with global Regulatory CMC objectives.
  • Ensure the team is equipped with the necessary skills, knowledge, and resources to excel in their roles.
  • Translate global CMC strategies into comprehensive regional plans, ensuring alignment with country-specific regulatory requirements.
  • Oversee the development and implementation of regional submission strategies to streamline processes and reduce duplication of effort.
  • Partner with global and regional stakeholders to identify opportunities for harmonization and efficiency.
  • Monitor and report on submission timelines and regulatory approvals, addressing any issues or delays proactively.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with local affiliates to understand and address country-specific regulatory needs and challenges.
  • Liaise with global Regulatory CMC teams to provide regional insights and feedback, ensuring a cohesive approach to regulatory submissions.
  • Represent the Regional CMC Liaison function in cross-functional and global meetings, advocating for regional needs and perspectives.
  • Identify and address bottlenecks in the regional submission process, proposing and implementing innovative solutions to enhance efficiency.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives, leveraging best practices and lessons learned to optimize regional submission processes.
  • Ensure compliance with regional and country-specific regulatory requirements and guidelines.

Education & Competencies (Technical and Behavioral):

  • BS/BA Degree in a Scientific Discipline, Advanced Degree (M.S), with Ph.D. preferred.
  • 15+ years of seasoned biopharmaceutical/device industry experience or with a regulatory agency is preferred, while leading major submissions during LCM, development - including preparation of NDA/NLA/MAA.
  • Equivalent industry experience with direct technical/product development experience such as Pharmaceutical Development, Analytical Development, Production, Quality Assurance can be considered.
  • People leadership experience (5+ years) required.
  • Highly proficient understanding of scientific principles and profound grasp of global regulatory CMC requirements relevant to global drug development and post-market support.
  • Keeping abreast of industry insights and regulatory trends to drive organizational evolution.
  • Proven ability to understand and communicate regulatory strategy to drug development, registration, and post-market support teams.
  • Analyze issues with attention to detail.
  • Ability to assess and scientifically justify alternative approaches.
  • Base regulatory strategy recommendations on precedents and other regulatory intelligence as well as regulations and guidelines.
  • Able to deal with issues of critical importance independently.
  • Exercises excellent judgment in elevating and communicating actual or potential issues to line management.
  • Understands who is responsible for different decisions, drives and escalates as necessary.
  • Implements the directions taken by the company, leading with agility through evolving landscapes.
  • Intentionally promotes an inclusive culture, leveraging individual strengths for team success.
  • Develops and drives prioritization framework, managing shifting priorities and tight deadlines.

Cientista de Dados Pleno

O Chaves na Mão é um dos principais portais de classificados de imóveis e veículos do Brasil. Nossa missão é conectar usuários a oportunidades reais, proporcionando uma experiência fluida, intuitiva e de alta performance.

A missão do Cientista de Dados é desenvolver e evoluir modelos de machine learning que gerem impacto direto no produto, no negócio e na experiência dos usuários. Você será responsável por transformar dados em inteligência de mercado, criando algoritmos, análises e soluções que melhorem conversão, previsão, personalização e tomada de decisão.

Responsabilidades

  • Criar, treinar e manter modelos de machine learning (supervisionados e não supervisionados).
  • Desenvolver modelos de recomendação, lead scoring, previsão e segmentação.
  • Construir pipelines completos (ingestão → preparação → treino → deploy → monitoramento).

  • Trabalhar em conjunto com times de Produto, Engenharia e Negócios para identificar problemas e oportunidades.
  • Realizar análises exploratórias, estudos estatísticos, testes e experimentações para validar hipóteses.
  • Transformar grandes volumes de dados estruturados e não estruturados em insights acionáveis.
  • Garantir documentação, versionamento, qualidade e reprodutibilidade dos modelos.
  • Criar métricas de avaliação, monitoramento e indicadores de impacto.

Requisitos

  • Formação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Matemática ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência sólida com Python (pandas, numpy, sklearn, PyTorch ou TensorFlow).
  • SQL avançado;
  • Experiência comprovada com machine learning aplicado a problemas reais.
  • Pamiliaridade com processos ETL/ELT e orquestração de dados.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de versionamento e boas práticas de engenharia.

title: Purchasing Manager
description:
SWM International is a multinational company specialized in producing paper for the tobacco industry and solutions in specialty papers. We are expert manufacturers of a variety of advanced materials that are part of people’s everyday lives. We contribute to our customers’ success by delivering high-quality products and collaborating to provide innovative and customized solutions that enhance the value of their offerings.

Now, we invite you to be part of our daily journey, where each employee is essential to the success of our company.

Bring your talent to SWM!

We are currently looking for a Purchasing Manager to join our team in a permanent position at our unit in Piraí, Rio de Janeiro.

Position Objective

Lead regional operational buying teams in executing global procurement strategies while managing supplier relationships locally and interfacing with key stakeholders like plant operational and maintenance teams. This role ensures compliance, operational excellence, cost optimization, and supply continuity by bridging the gap between corporate global strategy and regional business needs.

Your challenges will include:

1. Operational Leadership & Strategy Execution

  • Manage Regional Buying Teams: Lead and develop the operational procurement team to ensure high performance, process compliance, and professional growth.
  • Implement global framework agreement: work closely with category leaders to roll out global contracts regionally, ensuring local requirements are met without compromising global leverage.
  • Drive orocess excellence: Apply Lean/Six Sigma principles to streamline the "procure-to-pay" cycle and improve regional buying efficiency.

2. Market Intelligence & Analysis

  • Monitor market trends: Analyze regional indices, competitor behavior, and technical developments to forecast price fluctuations and supply risks.
  • Benchmarking: Regularly compare regional pricing and commercial terms against competitors to maintain a competitive edge while ensuring full legal and anti-trust compliance.
  • Data-driven reporting: Consolidate market research and internal KPIs into actionable monthly reports to guide executive decision-making.

3. Supplier & Stakeholder Management

  • Local face to suppliers: Act as the primary regional point of contact for key suppliers to resolve escalations, conduct performance reviews, and ensure service level agreements (SLAs) are met.
  • Risk Mitigation: Proactively identify supply chain bottlenecks and develop alternative sourcing formulations or backup plans.
  • Sourcing: Lead team to run competitive tenders for categories under direct responsibility

4. Continuous Improvement & Compliance

  • Knowledge Leadership: Stay current on industry innovations and digital procurement tools to suggest improvements in commercial positioning.
  • EHS & Quality Standards: Ensure all regional purchasing activities strictly adhere to Health, Safety, Environment, and corporate governance guidelines.
  • Compliance: Establish and enforce local procedures, ensuring transparency in the purchasing activities

What we’re looking for:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Administration, Engineering, or related fields
  • Experience: Solid knowledge of purchasing processes, negotiation, and import/export regulations;
  • Technical Skills: Training in Purchasing and Supply Chain/ Proficiency in Microsoft Office/ Experience with ERP and P2P softwares.
  • Languages: Fluency in English, any other language is a plus
  • Availability to travel.

What we offer:

  • Eye Care: Reimbursement of up to R$ 544.00 (frames and lenses) per year.
  • Group Life Insurance: Sul América Insurance, with monthly employee contribution through payroll deduction.
  • Dental Plan: Amil 700, family, with national coverage.
  • Private pension plan
  • Christmas gift card
  • Meal voucher
  • On-site meals
  • Pharmacy voucher
  • Transportation allowance
  • Toys – children up to 12 years old

title: Head of AML (MLRO)
description:
At bet365, we're one of the world's leading online gambling companies, revolutionising the industry since 2000. Founded by Denise Coates CBE, we now employ over 9,000 people and serve over 100 million customers in 27 languages. Our focus on In-Play betting has solidified our market-leading position, offering an unmatched experience across 96 sports and 700,000 streaming events. With over 750 concurrent sporting fixtures at peak and more live sports streamed than anyone else in Europe, we handle over 6 billion requests daily and process more than 2 million bets per hour at peak.

We empower our employees to push boundaries and explore new ideas, cultivating a culture that celebrates and rewards creativity. This offers employees a wealth of opportunities for growth, giving them the opportunity to make a real impact in the world of online gambling. As a forward-thinking company, we’re breaking new ground in software innovation too, redefining what’s possible for our customers worldwide.

Job Description

An experienced and highly motivated Head of AML (MLRO) to lead our Anti-Money Laundering (AML) efforts in Brazil.

You will be responsible for developing, implementing, and overseeing our AML programme, ensuring adherence to local regulations.

Please apply with an English version of your CV.

Qualifications

  • Relevant qualifications, including Association of Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialists (ACAMS) certification.
  • Proven experience in AML compliance within the online gambling or financial services industry.
  • In-depth knowledge of Brazilian AML regulations and international standards.

Additional Information

  • Developing and implementing a comprehensive AML strategy in line with Brazilian regulations and international best practices.
  • Acting as the Money Laundering Reporting Officer (MLRO) and serving as the primary point of contact for all AML related matters.
  • Monitoring and assessing the effectiveness of the AML programme, making necessary adjustments to policies and procedures as required.
  • Conducting risk assessments to identify and mitigate potential AML risks associated with our operations.
  • Overseeing the customer due diligence (CDD) process, ensuring compliance with KYC (Know Your Customer) requirements.
  • Providing training and guidance to staff on AML policies, procedures, and regulatory obligations.
  • Liaising with regulatory authorities, law enforcement agencies, and other stakeholders on AML matters.
  • Preparing and submitting required reports to regulatory bodies, including suspicious activity reports (SARs).
  • Keeping up to date with emerging trends and changes in AML regulations, ensuring the company remains compliant.
  • Collaborating with other departments to promote a culture of compliance and integrity within the organisation.

title: Coordenador de eventos
description:
Vaga: Coordenador de Planejamento e Produção de Eventos

Sobre a Welcome:

Somos uma empresa de assessoria em viagens com o propósito de criar experiências e transformar pessoas. Nossa atuação é dividida em três frentes especializadas: Welcome Weddings , setor especializado em Destination Wedding, com assessoria completa e personalizada desde a da produção do casamento até a viagem. A Welcome Trips que é o setor especializado em viagens de lazer, onde a personalização e a excelência são a essência de cada roteiro, e Welcome Corp, focada em viagens corporativas e de incentivo.

A Welcome Weddings é reconhecida internacionalmente como a melhor produtora de Destination Wedding da América Latina. Mais do que realizar casamentos, nossa missão é realizar o melhor dia da vida do casal.

Os setores de Planejamento e Produção de Eventos são responsáveis por conceber, organizar e coordenar todos os detalhes de um Destination Wedding, desde a escolha do destino e do local ideais até a execução impecável de cada evento. A equipe compreende profundamente o perfil e os desejos do casal, orienta nas decisões mais adequadas, realiza a reserva da data, o bloqueio de apartamentos no hotel definido e estrutura toda a programação dos eventos. Além disso, conecta o casal aos profissionais ideais e garante que cada elemento reflita sua visão, proporcionando uma experiência única, personalizada e memorável.

Sua missão:

Sua missão será liderar, integrar e garantir a excelência de todo o processo do Destination Wedding , atuando da concepção à entrega final para garantir o propósito da Welcome Weddings que é realizar o melhor dia da vida do casal.

Suas responsabilidades:

  • Coordenar a operação completa dos eventos;
  • Liderar e orientar as equipes;
  • Supervisionar a escolha dos destinos e locais;
  • Acompanhar e validar reservas e bloqueios;
  • Garantir a estruturação da programação dos eventos;
  • Assegurar a personalização e a qualidade da entrega;
  • Monitorar a experiência do casal do início ao fim.

Suas principais atividades:

Acompanhar a jornada de cada casal com base nos processos de Planejamento e Produção, garantindo alinhamento, qualidade e personalização em todas as etapas. Estruturar, aprimorar e monitorar continuamente os processos de Planejamento e Produção junto à Wedding Planner responsável por cada projeto. Apoiar as demandas operacionais dos departamentos, definindo a Wedding Planner responsável por cada casal em cada fase do processo. Conduzir reuniões estratégicas semanais com os departamentos, promovendo alinhamento e tomada de decisão. Desenvolver e capacitar os times, apoiando o Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI) de cada colaborador. Atuar como elo entre coordenadores e diretoria, assegurando comunicação clara e estratégica. Prevenir e gerenciar situações de crise, garantindo soluções rápidas, eficazes e alinhadas aos valores da empresa. Acompanhar metas e indicadores de desempenho de cada setor, identificando oportunidades de melhoria e propondo soluções. Gerir o relacionamento com fornecedores estratégicos e representar a Welcome em eventos institucionais e do mercado de eventos.

A Tereos acredita que todos os profissionais podem contribuir com o crescimento do grupo. Por isso, pessoas com deficiência são bem-vindas a nossa empresa.

Sobre a Tereos

Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. Os compromissos do Grupo com a sociedade e com o meio ambiente têm contribuído com a performance da companhia no longo prazo, enquanto reforça nossa atuação responsável. O Grupo cooperativo Tereos reúne 12.000 agricultores e possui expertise reconhecida no processamento de beterraba, cana-de-açúcar, cereais e batata. Com operação em 15 países, 43 unidades industriais e o compromisso de 15.800 colaboradores, a Tereos atende seus clientes em seus mercados locais, com uma oferta ampla de produtos. Em 2022/23, o Grupo obteve um faturamento de € 6,6 bilhões.

Tereos no Brasil

A Tereos no Brasil é composta pela Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil, Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil e Tereos Commodities Brasil. No noroeste do Estado de São Paulo, a Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil concentra suas sete unidades de processamento e duas refinarias. A Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil, com operação em Palmital (SP), diversifica o portfólio da Tereos Brasil com a fabricação de produtos derivados de milho. A Tereos Commodities opera como trading e possui escritórios em diversos países.

title: Security & Loss Prevention Supervisor
description:
Who are we?

Samsung Electronics has grown into one of the world’s leading technology companies, recognized as one of the top 5 global brands. As a global leader in technology, we are transforming the world with the creativity and diversity of our talented people who drive this transformation.

Our company's success reflects the determination and talent of our people, aligned with our key corporate values: People, Excellence, Change, Integrity, and Co-prosperity. Our mission is to help people achieve the impossible.

We are inspired by what people want to accomplish in their lives and work to create products that empower them in new ways. This drive fuels our innovation.

Join us at Samsung and find your opportunity to do what you can't.

Looking for more? Visit our website or our career page HERE !

Job Overview:

The Security & Loss Prevention Supervisor is responsible for leading the implementation of security services and asset protection across all logistics activities, including transportation, warehouses, and hubs. This role oversees the Security & Loss Prevention department, conducting audits and investigations to minimize potential losses for the organization. Coordinates responses to on-road incidents such as thefts, pilferages, and accidents, and evaluates vendors to identify vulnerabilities and propose mitigation strategies. As a key member of the logistics team, they collaborate with operational teams, internal departments like Legal and Finance, as well as external security authorities. Additionally, they work with internal and external stakeholders to continuously improve existing solutions, explore new approaches, conduct industry benchmarking, and track established metrics for loss prevention.

Key Job Responsibilities:

  • Be aware of the goals and direction of the Company and align all decisions and activities to support that direction and achieve the goals, which are key performance indicators, allowing performance improvements.
  • Lead investigations of internal and external occurrences, some cases involving police department in all states.
  • Serve as department’s liaison and security matter expert.
  • Develop business cases which receive the required approval, financial and technical resources, and the support of appropriate management to enact desired changes
  • Drive process improvements and increase efficiency by apply innovation initiatives (AI, drones, new technologies, etc.).
  • Designing and implementing the security and loss prevention strategy, standards and procedures.
  • Driving internal and external (vendors) audits to ensure that losses are kept at a minimal level.
  • Designing security procedures for all logistics processes, mainly for transportation and warehouses.
  • Effectively address security incidents. Detecting and addressing any discrepancies/pilferage for key metrics.
  • Participate in projects like warehouse layout (placement or cameras, security system, etc) and transportation monitoring center software as examples.
  • Background & Experience
  • A completed Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited university
  • Prior experience in law enforcement, asset protection, audit, risk management or other related security field
  • Familiarity with security equipment such as intrusion detection devices, access control systems, alarms, and CCTVs;
  • Results oriented leader that possesses strong influencing skill and is comfortable working in a fast-paced ambiguous environment while prioritizing and managing multiple responsibilities;
  • Analytical leader experienced in performance based, action and results oriented management, and effective problem-solver;
  • Ability to take calculated risks and challenge current practices to develop and deliver innovative solutions to meet or exceed the customer expectations.
  • English level intermediate is mandatory.

Our history is built on overcoming challenges and striving for excellence. Join us in pushing the boundaries of technology and innovation.

title: Finance Senior Analyst
description:
About MGI

In April 2024, MGI Tech opened a Customer Experience Center in Brazil to contribute to the advancement of genomics in Latin America. The goal is to provide a facility for clinical and research laboratories, hospitals, and universities to enhance learning and experience with genetic sequencing technology, applied in precision medicine, oncology, Agri genomics (the application of genomics in agriculture), and metagenomics (the study of environmental microbial communities), among other segments. MGI Brazil is committed to enabling effective and affordable healthcare solutions for all. Based on its proprietary technology, MGI produces sequencing devices, equipment, consumables, and reagents to support life science research, medicine, and healthcare. MGI is recognized globally as an innovator and for conducting international collaborative projects with leading research institutions for the betterment of mankind and the world in which we live. MGI values its employees, as we believe they are the driving force behind our success and commercial expansion globally.

POSITION PROFILE

MGI is seeking an in-country finance professional to play an important role in the expansion of business operations in Brazil. This position will be responsible for ensuring accurate and timely financials for MGI-Brazil as well as managing the contract accounting firm for Brazil operations and liaison with the commercial team in Brazil. In order to achieve success in this role the position requires the ability to collaborate effectively across all functions and levels, as well as across international boundaries, with finance teams in the US and Shenzhen, China.

Reporting to the US Finance Director, the position is based in São Paulo, Brazil.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Financial Operation:

  • Oversee day-to-day accounting operations, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, payroll, and general ledger activities.
  • Support customer invoicing and sales tax calculation.
  • Ensure timely and accurate processing of financial transactions.
  • Maintain and improve internal controls and financial procedures.
  • Support financial processes and IT system improvements (e.g., CRM, Oracle ERP, Concur, internally designed Shared Service Platform)

Month-end Closing and Reporting:

  • Responsible for over-seeing the contract accounting team in Brazil.
  • Prepare Month-end closing and ensure accurate and timely Finance Statements are submitted to HQ Reporting team.
  • Arrange stock take and fixed assets take procedures.

Tax Compliance and annual audit support:

  • Ensure compliance with local and international accounting standards and regulatory requirements.
  • Work with tax consultants to prepare and file tax returns, ensuring compliance with local tax regulations.
  • Support group annual audit procedures (i.e. audit confirmations and PBC list)

Cash Management:

  • Monitor and manage the company's cash flow, ensuring sufficient liquidity for operations.
  • Own the cash management function and liaison with treasury administrator in US.

Budgeting and Forecasting:

  • Participate in the annual budgeting process for MGI Brazil and Actual v Budget analysis.
  • Monitor financial performance against budgets and forecasts, identifying variances and recommending corrective actions.

Commercial Team Support:

  • Build relationships with and support the Brazil Commercial team.
  • Identify opportunities for cost reduction and efficiency improvements.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • At least 5 years of relevant accounting experience in a fast-paced, fluid, results-oriented, hands-on environment, including with teams that are geographically dispersed across international boundaries.
  • Strong knowledge of accounting principles, financial regulations, and reporting standards.
  • Experience with ERP and Financial IT systems (e.g., CRM, Oracle ERP, Concur, etc.)
  • BS/BA degree in Accounting/Finance/Business. CPA a plus.
  • Biotechnology/Medical Devices/Pharmaceutical industry experience and multinational experience; experience with import tax a plus.
  • Proven experience in instrument sales or related industry is a plus.
  • Knowledge of Portuguese and English is required. Chinese language a plus.
  • Must have strong excel skills.

BEHAVIORS, SKILLS, AND KNOWLEDGE

  • Team-oriented with outstanding integrity, accuracy, and organizational skills.
  • Ability to proactively identify and solve problems.
  • Exhibits the highest degree of integrity and ethics, with the ability to work independently and with minimal supervision.
  • Strong team player willing to be flexible and to tackle a variety of tasks and responsibilities.
  • Ability to navigate and be successful in a highly matrixed, fast-paced environment.
  • Results-oriented with excellent analytic, communication, and collaboration skills
  • Ability to operate under different business models and complex business structures.

title: API Engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for API Designer/Engineer who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Overview

The API Designer/Engineer is a pivotal role responsible for implementing API Design First principles to create scalable, secure, and consumer-centric APIs. The candidate will focus on designing API specifications and frameworks that ensure seamless developer experiences while meeting Customer's API standards and architectural guidelines.

Key Responsibilities

API Design & Development

  • Adopt an API Design First Approach : Leverage OpenAPI (Swagger), RAML, or AsyncAPI specifications to define APIs before implementation, ensuring clarity and alignment across stakeholders.
  • API Specification Creation : Design API specifications that adhere to Customer's API standards, covering endpoints, data structures, error handling, and response codes.
  • Policy Design and Configuration : Define and configure API policies (security, routing, transformation, throttling, etc.) using tools such as Azure API Management (APIM).
  • Mock API Development : Create mock APIs for early-stage validation and testing to facilitate integration and feedback before development.
  • API Testing : Perform unit testing of API specifications to ensure functionality, reliability, and adherence to defined standards.
  • Environment Configuration : Configure API backend settings within APIM (naming conventions, App Insights, Key Vault) in DEV, UAT, and PRD environments.
  • API Deployment : Deploy draft APIs into the Azure APIM Dev instance and promote them across DEV, UAT, and PRD environments using the API DevOps framework.
  • Documentation : Create comprehensive API documentation, including references, developer guides, and examples, in line with Customer's standards.
  • Metadata Publishing : Publish API Identity Cards (metadata, usage information) to the Azure API Management Developer Portal to enable easy discovery and adoption by consumers.

API Consumer Onboarding

  • Secure Authentication Setup : Configure OAuth/OpenID Connect to ensure secure authentication and authorization for API consumers.
  • Subscription Key Management : Share API subscription keys securely with consumers and maintain robust tracking mechanisms.
  • Integration Testing Support : Collaborate with API consumers during integration testing to resolve issues and provide guidance on proper usage.

Testing & Validation

  • Functional Testing : Conduct and support API functional, integration, and performance testing to validate API readiness and scalability.
  • Mock and Staging Environment Management : Ensure availability of mock services and staging environments for API testing and feedback gathering.

Skills and Expertise

  • API Design First Expertise : Proficient in designing APIs using OpenAPI, SwaggerHub, or similar tools with a focus on consumer-first design principles.
  • Azure API Management : Deep experience in configuring and managing APIs using Azure API Management.
  • Security Standards : Strong knowledge of OAuth2, OpenID Connect, and API key management best practices.
  • Documentation Excellence : Skilled in creating developer-friendly documentation and API identity cards.
  • Testing Proficiency : Familiarity with API testing frameworks and methodologies to validate functionality and performance. Proficient in using Postman tool

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

About InComm

InComm is a global leader in the payments industry with over 30 years of experience and a presence in 30+ countries. As pioneers in gift cards, we hold two-thirds of the global market share.

title: GoHigh Level Specialist
description:
GoHigh Level Specialist

Company: OutfitMD

Department: Operations / Technology

Reports To: CEO & Leadership Team

Role Overview

The GoHigh Level Specialist is responsible for owning, managing, and optimizing the entire backend technology and automation infrastructure for OutfitMD. This role serves as the internal technical authority for CRM systems, workflows, automations, integrations, and platform performance.

This position ensures OutfitMD has full internal control, visibility, and scalability of its systems. The role is highly technical, execution-focused, and critical to the company’s ability to scale efficiently By maintaining strong internal ownership of platform logic and automation, this role enables seamless operations across Sales, Implementation, Client Success, and Marketing ensuring systems evolve alongside the business and can reliably support increased volume, complexity, and long-term expansion.

Primary Objectives

• Own and manage OutfitMD’s CRM and automation ecosystem

• Build, maintain, and optimize GHL workflows and automations

• Eliminate dependency on external GHL vendors

• Ensure system stability, scalability, and performance

• Support Implementation, Client Success, and Sales through reliable systems

Core Responsibilities

CRM & Automation Ownership

• Serve as the primary internal expert for GoHighLevel

• Build and maintain workflows, automations, triggers, and pipelines

• Configure forms, calendars, intake processes, and communication logic

• Manage integrations with third-party tools (SMS, email, payment processors, etc.)

• Maintain clean data structures, tagging, and segmentation

Implementation & Technical Support

• Support Implementation Support Specialists with backend builds

• Execute technical setup for new client portals

• Troubleshoot automation failures, bugs, and system issues

• Test and QA systems before client launch

System Optimization & Scaling

• Identify inefficiencies, redundancies, and automation gaps

• Optimize workflows for speed, accuracy, and scalability

• Prepare systems to support increased client volume

• Document technical SOPs and system logic

Security, Compliance & Reliability

• Ensure systems follow best practices for data handling and access control

• Manage user permissions and access levels

• Monitor system uptime and automation health

Internal Collaboration

• Work closely with Sales, Implementation, Client Success, and Marketing

• Translate business needs into technical solutions

• Provide leadership with technical insight and recommendations

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

• Automation reliability and uptime

• Reduction in system errors or failures

• Time to resolve technical issues

• Successful internalization of GHL management

• System scalability and performance metrics

Required Skills & Qualifications

• Advanced experience with GoHighLevel CRM

• Advanced English

• Strong understanding of automation logic and workflows

• Experience with CRM architecture, pipelines, and data structure

• Ability to troubleshoot technical issues independently

• Strong documentation and organizational skills

• Ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical teams

Preferred

• Experience replacing or auditing third-party CRM vendors

• Background in SaaS, automation, or technical operations

• Familiarity with HIPAA-aware systems (non-clinical)

Why this role matters at outfitmd

The GoHighLevel Specialist ensures our marketing and sales systems run efficiently and produce measurable results. This role is responsible for setting up and optimizing automations, funnels, and CRM workflows so every lead is properly captured, followed up with, and moved through the sales process without manual effort.

By translating business goals into scalable systems, the GoHighLevel Specialist reduces lead loss, improves conversion rates, and supports sustainable growth. This role turns GoHighLevel into a reliable, revenue-driving platform rather than just another software tool.

title: Especialista em segurança do trabalho
description:
O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.

Sobre a Arauco Brasil

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Sobre a Função

DESAFIO

Aplicar as estratégias de Segurança do trabalho e Emergências, trabalhando na prevenção de acidentes e promoção da saúde ocupacional, fazendo cumprir as normas de segurança, monitorando indicadores, se antecipando e evitando situações de Emergências e/ou acidentes, garantindo a consolidação da cultura de segurança, visando um ambiente seguro para todos os colaboradores e minimizando riscos operacionais em sua área de atuação.

Atividades principais

  • Elaborar, buscar aprovação, implementar e manter políticas e programas de segurança do trabalho, alinhados às legislações vigentes (NRs – Normas Regulamentadoras) e às necessidades da sua área de atuação promovendo a cultura de segurança no ambiente de trabalho, assegurando que todos os colaboradores conheçam e sigam as diretrizes de segurança;
  • Identificar riscos potenciais nas atividades da sua área de atuação;
  • Treinar e conscientizar os colaboradores sobre a importância do uso de EPIs e supervisionar sua utilização no ambiente de trabalho, assim como, garantir que os EPIs estejam em conformidade com as regulamentações e com a NR-6;
  • Planejar e ministrar treinamentos obrigatórios e periódicos sobre segurança do trabalho, como NR-12 (Segurança em Máquinas e Equipamentos), NR-33 (Espaços Confinados) e NR-35 (Trabalho em Altura), entre outros;
  • Treinar equipes de emergência e primeiros socorros, capacitando os colaboradores para agir em casos de acidentes ou situações críticas.
  • Realizar inspeções regulares nas áreas produtivas, verificando as condições de trabalho, equipamentos, máquinas e infraestrutura para identificar e corrigir potenciais irregularidades;
  • Coordenar auditorias internas e externas de segurança, bem como, acompanhar as auditorias de certificação como OHSAS 18001 ou ISO 45001, e implementar planos de ação para melhorias contínuas na segurança dos colaboradores;
  • Investigar acidentes e incidentes de trabalho, levantando dados, fatos e evidências, realizando as análises conforme metodologia pré-definida;
  • Monitorar e analisar os indicadores de segurança;
  • Implementar e manter programas como o Programa de Prevenção de Riscos Ambientais (PPRA) e o Programa de Controle Médico de Saúde Ocupacional (PCMSO) , em conformidade com a NR-9 e NR-7;
  • Implementar o Plano de Atendimento a Emergências (PAE) , assegurando que os colaboradores estejam preparados para lidar com emergências;
  • Coordenar a eleição, formação e atuação da CIPA , em conformidade com a NR-5, garantindo a capacitação dos participantes;
  • Garantir que os sistemas de prevenção e combate a incêndios estejam instalados, funcionando adequadamente e em conformidade com a legislação vigente;
  • Desenvolver e acompanhar KPIs (indicadores-chave de desempenho) de segurança, como taxa de frequência de acidentes , taxa de gravidade , acidentes com afastamento etc.;
  • Colaborar com o setor de saúde ocupacional para monitorar a saúde dos trabalhadores;
  • Manter atualizados os documentos de segurança, como laudos técnicos, PPRA, PCMSO, LTCAT (Laudo Técnico de Condições Ambientais de Trabalho) e relatórios de inspeções e auditorias;
  • Elaborar relatórios periódicos de segurança, apresentando os resultados e avanços das iniciativas implementadas à diretoria e às áreas operacionais;
  • Garantir que todas as práticas de segurança estejam em conformidade com as normas regulamentadoras do Ministério do Trabalho;
  • Participar e apoiar projetos de melhorias, inovação, modificações e modernização de sistemas e processos relacionados à Segurança do trabalho e Emergências;

title: Data Migration Specialist
description:
Data Engineer

Location: Brazil, Fully Remote

Type: Full-time (8 hours/day)

Setup: Consultancy / Freelance

Level: Senior-Mid Level

Industry: Software IT / SaaS

Shift: EST Time Zone

Equipment: Must have own machine; equipment not provided

Position Overview

We are seeking a skilled Data Engineer to design, build, and optimize data migration pipelines that enable seamless transitions from legacy systems into our SaaS platform. You will work closely with both customers and internal teams to ensure data accuracy, reliability, and long-term scalability across our product ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and implement ETL/ELT pipelines to migrate customer data from various legacy systems into the SDL SaaS platform
  • Transform datasets across multiple formats (e.g., SQL databases, APIs, flat files like CSV) ensuring data integrity and consistency
  • Build reusable components and tooling that support repeatable and scalable migration processes
  • Automate data extraction, transformation, and loading workflows to improve performance and efficiency
  • Partner with customers and cross-functional teams to deeply understand data requirements and resolve data-related challenges
  • Apply best practices in code quality, testing, CI/CD, and deployment to maintain a robust engineering ecosystem
  • Participate in peer code reviews and contribute to evolving engineering standards as we scale
  • Support ongoing process improvement by helping build foundational data engineering capabilities

Job Requirements

  • Proven experience in data engineering , ETL development , or data migration within a SaaS environment
  • Proficiency in Python for data transformation and automation scripting
  • Strong hands-on knowledge of SQL and experience working with relational databases
  • Ability to work with multiple data formats (e.g., CSV, structured/unstructured sources)
  • Strong analytical mindset with high attention to data accuracy and quality
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Knowledge of software development best practices, including version control and code reviews

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with GIS technologies and spatial data formats such as shapefiles
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, Azure)
  • Experience building scalable data pipelines and automating complex workflows
  • Understanding of distributed systems or large-scale data processing architectures

description:
